headline: Ziff Davis Reports Q3 Earnings Beat But Revenue Misses Estimates
summary: Ziff Davis reported an earnings per share beat by $0.18, while its revenue fell short of analyst estimates.
why: Quarterly earnings reports provide critical insights into a company's profitability and revenue growth, driving near-term stock price movements.

impacts.name: Ziff Davis
impacts.why: Mixed earnings results with an EPS beat and revenue miss directly impact investor valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Discrepancies between reported earnings, revenue figures, and market expectations typically trigger immediate stock price adjustments.
